# Skin model fixture

`Fox.glb` is the unmodified Fox sample from the [Khronos glTF Sample Assets repository](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/Fox). It exercises embedded textures, a skinned mesh, and the Survey, Walk and Run animation clips. It is used only in tests and is not included in the extension.

`vrm-fixture.mjs` builds synthetic VRM 0 and 1 avatars in memory with a textured MToon material,
humanoid bones, a skinned head, a morph expression and spring hair. It covers import, frame updates,
customization and portable round trips without including third-party character artwork.
